content.content:
## 2. Export format: `run-state.json` version 1.2.0 (produced by `workflow/export_state.py`, consumed by `server/projects.ts`, mimicked by `tests/project-workflows/seed.ts`)

Everything from 1.0.0 stays exactly as is (`version`, `run_id`, `base_commit`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `definition`, `values`, `next`, `tasks`, `events`, `verification_packets`). Two keys are added. `version` becomes `"1.2.0"`. The adapter must accept versions `1.0.0` (no `review`/`inputs` keys), `1.1.0` (`review` key, no `inputs`) and `1.2.0` (both). When a key is present its value is the object below or `null`.

```jsonc
"review": null | {
  "attempt": 1,
  "transport": "native" | "print" | "manual",
  "reviewer_session_id": "dd7bdcd1-adec-4efe-bcd4-bbadc3525d95",   // Claude session UUID, or the operator-stated identity for manual reviews (review.json "reviewer")
  "independent": true,
  "bundle_sha256": "<64 hex>",
  "candidate_commit": "<40 hex>",
  "verdict": "approved" | "blocked",
  "findings": [ { "severity": "P0|P1|P2", "message": "...", "disposition": "open|resolved|accepted",
                  "worker": "ui|adapter|both|none" | null, "requirement": "verbatim quote" | null } ],
  "reviewed_at": "2026-09-21T15:42:27.848828Z",                    // ISO 8601, UTC, trailing Z
  "diff": null | { "path": "review.diff", "sha256": "<64 hex>", "bytes": 289187 }   // relative to the run root
},
"inputs": null | {
  "feature": "Project-scoped workflow graph and run viewer",     // policy.json "feature"
  "policy_version": "1.1.0",
  "base_commit": "<40 hex>",
  "source_branch": "feature/project-workflows/project-workflows-001" | null,
  "mode": "automatic" | "manual",                                  // "automatic" iff plan.json has "automatic"
  "automatic": null | { "finish": "verified-feature-branch", "permission_mode": "bypassPermissions",
                        "worker_timeout_seconds": 3600, "review_timeout_seconds": 1800, "reviewer_transport": "native" | "print" },
                                                                  // reviewer_transport defaults to "native" when the plan predates it
  "setup": [ { "argv": ["npm", "ci"], "command": "npm ci", "timeout_seconds": 600 } ],   // command = Python shlex.join(argv)
  "max_verification_attempts": 3,
  "failure_drill": null | { "node_id": "adapter", "phase": "worker", "attempt": 1 },
  "workers": {
    "ui": {
      "role": "frontend",
      "task": "<plan.nodes.ui.task verbatim>",                     // authored task + "\nApproved ownership and checks:\n{...}"
      "prompt": "<contents of ui.prompt.txt>" | null,               // the exact prompt the native session received; null when the run did not record it
      "owned_paths": ["src/App.tsx", "..."],
      "checks": [ { "id": "frontend-build", "kind": "build", "argv": ["npm","run","build"], "command": "npm run build", "timeout_seconds": 180, "scenarios": [ {"id": "...", "description": "..."} ] } ],
      "launch": null | { "session_id": "<uuid>" | null, "launch_token": "<uuid>", "launch_requested_at": "2026-09-21T14:33:25.331982Z",
                         "native_started_at": 1790001207771 | null,   // epoch milliseconds as claude agents reports it
                         "observed_state": "working" | null, "status": "attached_session_available", "launcher_invocations": 1, "background_id": "68269267" | null },
      "completion": null | { "status": "completed" | "blocked", "summary": "...", "open_assumptions": ["..."] },
      "handoff": null | { "summary": "...", "open_assumptions": ["..."] },
      "stop": null | { "stopped": true, "confirmed_at": "2026-09-21T14:59:12.000000Z" | null }   // confirmed_at = stop.json mtime when stopped, else null
    },
    "adapter": { ...same shape... }
  }
}
```

Derivation rules (Python side, all read-only, all files optional except plan.json):
- `review`: `null` unless `review.json` exists. `transport`: `native` if `review.interactive.json` exists; else `print` if `automatic-review.json` exists; else `manual`. `reviewer_session_id` = `review.json["reviewer"]`. `reviewed_at`: `automatic-review.json["accepted_at"]` when present, else the time of the last `events.jsonl` record with `node == "review"`, else the mtime of `review.json`. `diff`: sha256 + size of `review.diff` when it is a regular file, else null. `findings[].worker` / `requirement` = the values in review.json, `null` when the key is absent (reviews recorded before slice A).
- `inputs`: `null` when `policy.json` is missing (very old fixtures); otherwise built from `plan.json` + `policy.json` + receipts. `launch.launch_requested_at` is normalised to a trailing-`Z` timestamp (receipts store `+00:00`). Worker `role`, `owned_paths`, `checks` come from the policy worker entry. `completion` is the raw `<worker>.completion.json` reduced to `{status, summary, open_assumptions}` (no validation beyond shape; a malformed file → `null`).
- `export_state` keeps its "unchanged content does not bump updated_at" rule; a re-export whose content differs (new version/sections) bumps `updated_at`. Hashing `review.diff` on every export is acceptable.

Adapter-side rules (TS): `exportSchema.version` accepts `'1.0.0' | '1.1.0' | '1.2.0'`; `review`/`inputs` optional-or-null; a present section is validated strictly (`RUN_STORAGE_INVALID` on violation, naming the run but never a path). Payload projection:
- `reviewResult.reviewer.session_id` = `reviewer_session_id`; `reviewed_at` passed through; `findings[].message` and `requirement` through `redactPaths`; `requirement_found_in` computed against the RAW (pre-redaction) `inputs.workers.<lane>.task` and `prompt` texts: lane included iff `requirement` is a verbatim substring of that lane's task text (or, when the task is missing, its prompt); empty when `requirement` is null or `inputs` is absent. `diff` = `{ artifact_id: "patch-review-" + sha256.slice(0,12), kind: "patch", uri: <run route>/artifacts/<artifact_id>, sha256 }` or null.
- `runInputs`: `workers` as an array in policy order with `node_id` = lane (`ui`), `launch_node_id` = `launch_<lane>` if that node exists in the pinned definition, else the lane; `task`/`prompt` texts through `redactPaths`, truncated to 65536 characters with the marker `\n\n[… truncated by the viewer API: N more characters]` and `truncated: true`; `launch.native_started_at` epoch ms → ISO Z string; `launch.launch_requested_at` normalised to Z; `setup[].command`, `checks[].command` passed through (never re-joined); `stop.confirmed_at` passed through.

----
### 3.5 Export (`export_state.py`)
- `EXPORT_VERSION = "1.2.0"`; add `review_section(directory)` and `inputs_section(directory, plan, policy)` per section 2; `export_state(runtime, state)` needs only `runtime.directory`, `runtime.plan` and (optionally) `runtime.policy`/`policy.json` on disk. Keep the existing test `test_export_is_stable_until_state_changes` passing (its runtime has no policy → `inputs: null`, no review → `review: null`).

### 3.6 Tests (extend the existing suites; new `workflow/test_export.py` is fine)
- `test_pipeline.FakeSessions` gains a reviewer: `run_reviewer(prompt, launch_token, candidate_commit)` writes `review.interactive.json` (fake UUID `33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333`, background id `33333333`) and, unless a `self.reviewer_verdict_file`/attribute says otherwise, writes a valid `review.completion.json` (verdict from a file the test controls, default approved, findings `[]`), then returns the receipt; `inventory()` returns rows for launched sessions with state `idle`; `locate(node, rows)` returns the matching row. `OfflinePipeline.stop_workers`/`stop_reviewer` stay no-ops that emit events. Keep `sessions.starts` recording `"review"` too.
- `test_automatic.AutomaticGraphTests`: the existing tests run under the default (native) transport with the fake reviewer; add a print-mode variant that pins `reviewer_transport: "print"` in the plan and keeps the fake executable assertions. Required new tests: (1) native happy path writes `review.interactive.json`, `review.completion.json` is accepted, `review.json` has findings with `worker`/`requirement`, `review.stop.json` exists, `review` events include the session UUID; (2) three-process recovery (`test_recovery_in_actual_new_controller_processes` style) where the first controller process is interrupted while waiting for the reviewer (simulate `KeyboardInterrupt` from `wait_review`) → receipt stays `running`, no stop file, reviewer still "running"; the next process resumes, accepts the completion and finishes; the reviewer is launched exactly once; (3) rejected completion files fail closed: wrong bundle hash, wrong launch token, wrong candidate commit, extra/missing keys, blocked verdict, unresolved P1 → `RuntimeError`, receipt `blocked`, no relaunch on a second `drive`; (4) `wait_review` deadline with the reviewer idle and no file → deadline error, `stop_reviewer` called; (5) print-mode fallback: the existing fake executable path still passes; (6) `validate_review` accepts findings with and without `worker`/`requirement` and rejects bad values.
- `test_interactive`: `run_reviewer` launch flags (`--bg`, `--tools Read,Glob,Grep,Write`, `--permission-mode dontAsk`, `--allowedTools Write(//...review.completion.json)`, `--add-dir <run>`, no `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, no `--print`), settle/late-PID reuse, `locate("review")` cwd = review-worktree, `attach_panels` third pane when the reviewer receipt exists, `attach_reviewer_panel` adds to an existing mapping and refuses a duplicate, worker `<node>.prompt.txt` written.
- `test_feature_launch`: `--reviewer-transport print` reaches prepare; `review-result` and `run-inputs` features validate and plan; export tests: a 1.0.0-shaped run directory re-exports to 1.2.0 with `review`/`inputs` sections and a second export is stable; export refuses a malformed review.json; export of a run without policy.json yields `inputs: null`.

### 3.7 Feature directories and launch choices
- `features/review-result/{feature.json,policy.json,ui-task.md,adapter-task.md,README.md}` and `features/run-inputs/{...}` following `features/project-workflows/` (same roles/ownership, policy version 1.1.0, `max_verification_attempts: 3`, no failure drill, setup `npm ci`). The `project-workflows-browser` check's scenarios: review-result = the six existing IDs plus `review-verdict`, `review-blocked`, `review-legacy`, `paths-redacted`; run-inputs = those ten plus `run-assignment`, `worker-inputs`, `finding-to-task`, `inputs-legacy`, `inputs-paths-redacted` (the PRD C table names its redaction scenario `paths-redacted`; in the browser suite the ID must be unique per test title, so use `inputs-paths-redacted` and say so in the README). `feature.json` `branch_prefix`: `feature/review-result`, `feature/run-inputs`. Task files describe the deliverables from the PRDs (sections 3 of PRD_REVIEW_RESULT.md / 5 of PRD_RUN_INPUTS.md) and the ownership boundary. `launch.py` `feature` choices: `project-workflows`, `review-result`, `run-inputs`; `--run-id` default derived from the feature (`<feature>-001`); the run-root default stays `~/.local/state/md-manager-workflows/<feature>`.

### 3.8 Docs
- `workflow/RUNBOOK.md`: automatic mode's review step (native reviewer session, third pane, completion protocol, `--reviewer-transport print`, deadline, no second reviewer), resuming the reviewer transcript (`cd <run>/review-worktree && claude --resume <uuid>`; transcripts live under `~/.claude/projects/<encoded worktree path>/<uuid>.jsonl`), `workflow export <run>`.
- `features/project-workflows/README.md`: the new files (`review.interactive.json`, `review.completion.json`, `review.stop.json`, `review.prompt.txt`, `<worker>.prompt.txt`), the runtime storage seam now exports version 1.2.0 with `review` and `inputs` (summarise section 2), and the re-export command.
- `workflow/README.md`: one paragraph. `contracts/workflow/README.md`: list `reviewCompletion.schema.json`.

## 4. Workstream S: server adapter

Owned paths: `server/**`, `config/projects.example.json`. Read `contracts/projects/v1.ts` and section 2 first.

- `server/projects.ts`: extend `exportSchema` (versions, `review`, `inputs` strict sub-schemas as in section 2, both `.nullable().optional()`); `LoadedRun` gains `review: ReviewResult | null` and `inputs: RunInputs | null` (projected lazily or eagerly, your call, but never trust `values`). Projection per section 2 (redaction, truncation, `requirement_found_in`, diff artifact). `projectSnapshot`: the `review` node gets `session_id = review.reviewer_session_id` and `result_uri = <run route>/reviews/<attempt>` when the export has a review section (status logic unchanged: task error → failed, evidence → succeeded …). Old exports without the section: `session_id`/`result_uri` stay null.
- Artifact route: a run-level registry beside packet artifacts: when the review section has `diff`, the artifact id `patch-review-<sha12>` resolves to `<run>/review.diff`, read bounded (`artifactByteLimit`), hash-verified, served `text/plain; charset=utf-8`, inline, with the same nosniff/CSP headers. Mismatch → `ARTIFACT_HASH_MISMATCH`; missing → `ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE`; ids that match neither registry → `ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND`.
- `server/projectRoutes.ts`: `GET /:project_id/workflows/:workflow_id/runs/:run_id/reviews/:attempt` → `conform(schemas.reviewResult, ...)` after `validateReviewResult`; 404 `REVIEW_NOT_FOUND` when the run has no review section or the attempt is not the recorded one; `GET .../runs/:run_id/inputs` → `conform(schemas.runInputs, ...)` after `validateRunInputs`; 404 `INPUTS_NOT_FOUND` when absent. Both routes get the 405 treatment for other methods. Error messages never contain paths.
- `server/projects.test.ts`: extend `writeRun` to accept `review`/`inputs` sections and an export `version`; tests for: review served with redaction (a finding message and a requirement quote containing an absolute path under the temp root come back with `<path>`), `requirement_found_in` computed only from verbatim matches (a quote found in the ui task → `['ui']`; a paraphrase → `[]`; null requirement → `[]`), diff artifact served and hash-checked and bounded, blocked review served with verdict blocked while the node projects `failed` (task error) and the run `failed`, legacy 1.0.0 export → 404 `REVIEW_NOT_FOUND`/`INPUTS_NOT_FOUND` and detail still 200 with `session_id`/`result_uri` null, 1.1.0 export (review, no inputs) loads, manual transport passes through the operator identity, inputs projection (task truncation at 65536 chars with marker, prompt null passthrough, timestamps normalised to Z, `stop.confirmed_at`, `launch_node_id`), malformed sections → 500 `RUN_STORAGE_INVALID` without paths, every new payload conforms to the committed schemas and cross-field validators, 405/HEAD on the new routes, nothing written into the run root.
- `config/projects.example.json`: unchanged unless you need to; do not embed private paths.

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { readFile, realpath } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { isAbsolute, resolve, sep } from 'node:path'
import { z } from 'zod'
import { validateDefinition, type WorkflowDefinition } from '../contracts/projects/v1.ts'

/**
 * The project registry: operator-configured associations between an opaque project ID, a repository and
 * one or more workflow run roots. Loaded once at startup from MD_MANAGER_PROJECTS_CONFIG, independently of
 * the skills configuration. Unset means an empty registry; an explicitly supplied file that is missing or
 * invalid fails startup. Requests can never add, change or select a root, and a run's own `plan.json` never
 * registers anything: runs belong to a workflow solely because they live under its configured `runs_root`.
 */
export const PROJECTS_CONFIG_ENV = 'MD_MANAGER_PROJECTS_CONFIG'
const SUPPORTED_VERSION = 1

/** A registry problem: the message is a local startup diagnostic and may name configured paths. */
export class ProjectsConfigError extends Error {}

export const ID_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$/
const NODE_KINDS = ['prepare', 'worker', 'verification', 'review', 'integration'] as const

/** The exact on-disk shape from the feature README. Anything else is rejected. */
const absoluteDirectory = z.string().min(1).refine(path => !path.includes('\0'), 'must not contain NUL characters')
  .refine(path => isAbsolute(path) && !path.startsWith('~'), 'must be an absolute path; "~", environment variables and relative paths are not expanded')
  .refine(path => resolve(path) !== sep, 'must not be the filesystem root')

const nodeSchema = z.strictObject({
  node_id: z.string().regex(ID_PATTERN),
  label: z.string().min(1),
  kind: z.enum(NODE_KINDS),
  depends_on: z.array(z.string().regex(ID_PATTERN)),
})

export const storedDefinitionSchema = z.strictObject({ name: z.string().min(1), nodes: z.array(nodeSchema).min(1) })

const workflowSchema = z.strictObject({
  workflow_id: z.string().regex(ID_PATTERN),
  runs_root: absoluteDirectory,
  definition: storedDefinitionSchema,
})

const projectSchema = z.strictObject({
  project_id: z.string().regex(ID_PATTERN),
  name: z.string().trim().min(1),
  repository: absoluteDirectory,
  workflows: z.array(workflowSchema),
})

const fileSchema = z.strictObject({ version: z.literal(SUPPORTED_VERSION), projects: z.array(projectSchema) })

export type StoredDefinition = z.infer<typeof storedDefinitionSchema>

export type WorkflowConfig = {
  workflow_id: string
  /** Absolute, normalized directory containing one sub-directory per run. */
  runs_root: string
  /** The current public definition, including its computed revision. */
  definition: WorkflowDefinition
}

            raise RuntimeError("Plan changed; refusing session reuse")

            raise RuntimeError("Existing launch cannot be reconciled; no automatic relaunch")
        receipt.update(status="attached_session_available", background_id=row["id"], session_id=row["sessionId"], observed_state=row["state"], native_started_at=row.get("startedAt"))
        receipt.pop("error", None)
        save_json(path, receipt)
        return receipt

    def launch(self, node: str, path: Path, receipt: dict, command: list[str], cwd: Path) -> dict:
        """Run the short `claude --bg` helper once, then bind the exact row it created."""
        env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if not key.startswith("HERDR_")}
        try:
            # This command creates Claude's own persistent terminal, then exits.
            # Killing this short helper is NOT evidence that the session stopped.
            with (self.directory / f"{node}.launch.log").open("w") as log:
                try:
                    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdout=log,
                                            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, timeout=self.timeout)
                finally:
                    log.flush()
                    os.fsync(log.fileno())
            if result.returncode != 0:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Claude background launch exited {result.returncode}; inspect launch log")
            row = self.settle(node)
            receipt.update(status="attached_session_available", background_id=row["id"], session_id=row["sessionId"], observed_state=row["state"], native_started_at=row.get("startedAt"))
        except BaseException as error:
            receipt.update(status="needs_reconciliation", error=str(error))
            raise
        finally:
            save_json(path, receipt)
        return receipt

"""Build run directories with the real Python exporter (several variants) plus a registry for the adapter."""
import json
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path("/home/agentops/dev/md-manager-ultra")
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))

from workflow.test_export import legacy_run, REVIEWER  # noqa: E402
from workflow.pipeline import ExportRuntime, export_run, build_pipeline  # noqa: E402
from workflow.export_state import GRAPH_NODES  # noqa: E402
from workflow.sessions import read_json, save_json  # noqa: E402
from workflow.checks import now  # noqa: E402

base = Path(sys.argv[1])
shutil.rmtree(base, ignore_errors=True)
roots = base / "roots"
roots.mkdir(parents=True)
(base / "repo").mkdir()


def variant(name, **kw):
    root = roots / name
    root.mkdir(parents=True)
    return legacy_run(root, **kw)


exports = {}

# 1. Finished run with a real LangGraph checkpoint (what the export test does), ui prompt recorded.
d = variant("legacy")
from langgraph.checkpoint.sqlite import SqliteSaver  # noqa: E402
runtime = ExportRuntime(d)
with SqliteSaver.from_conn_string(str(d / "pipeline.sqlite")) as saver:
    graph = build_pipeline(saver, runtime)
    graph.update_state({"configurable": {"thread_id": "legacy-001"}}, {"run_id": "legacy-001", "integrated_commit": "d" * 40}, as_node="integrate")
(d / "ui.prompt.txt").write_text("You are a workflow worker.\n\n# ui task")
exports["legacy"] = export_run(ExportRuntime(d))

# 2. Prepared, never started: no checkpoint, no previous export.
d = variant("prepared")
(d / "run-state.json").unlink()
exports["prepared"] = export_run(ExportRuntime(d))

# 3. No policy.json → inputs null.
d = variant("nopolicy", with_policy=False)
exports["nopolicy"] = export_run(ExportRuntime(d))

# 4. Manual plan (no automatic block, no source_branch), manual review (no receipts), no review event → mtime.
d = variant("manual", automatic=False)
(d / "automatic-review.json").unlink()
events = [json.loads(line) for line in (d / "events.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
(d / "events.jsonl").write_text("".join(json.dumps(e) + "\n" for e in events if e["node"] != "review"))
plan = read_json(d / "plan.json")
del plan["source_branch"]
save_json(d / "plan.json", plan)
exports["manual"] = export_run(ExportRuntime(d))

# 5. Native reviewer, accepted_at from now(), blocked verdict, findings with worker/requirement (old and new style mixed).
d = variant("native")
save_json(d / "review.interactive.json", {"node_id": "review", "session_id": REVIEWER, "launch_token": "11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555",
                                          "status": "attached_session_available", "launcher_invocations": 1,
                                          "launch_requested_at": "2026-09-21T15:00:00.000000+00:00"})
receipt = read_json(d / "automatic-review.json")
receipt.update(transport="native", accepted_at=now())
save_json(d / "automatic-review.json", receipt)
review = read_json(d / "review.json")
review["verdict"] = "blocked"
review["findings"] = [
    {"severity": "P1", "message": "The ui work was not done", "disposition": "open", "worker": "ui", "requirement": "Do the ui work."},
    {"severity": "P2", "message": "Cross-cutting", "disposition": "accepted", "worker": "none", "requirement": None},
    {"severity": "P2", "message": "Old style finding", "disposition": "resolved"},
]
save_json(d / "review.json", review)
plan = read_json(d / "plan.json")
plan["automatic"]["reviewer_transport"] = "native"
save_json(d / "plan.json", plan)
exports["native"] = export_run(ExportRuntime(d))

# 6. Partial receipts: malformed adapter completion, missing handoff/launch, unconfirmed stop, ui receipt without
#    startedAt/observed_state/session/background, no review.diff.
d = variant("partial")
(d / "adapter.completion.json").write_text("{not json")
(d / "adapter.handoff.json").unlink()
(d / "adapter.interactive.json").unlink()
save_json(d / "adapter.stop.json", {"stopped": False})
r = read_json(d / "ui.interactive.json")
r.pop("native_started_at")
r.pop("observed_state")
r["session_id"] = None
r["background_id"] = None
save_json(d / "ui.interactive.json", r)
(d / "review.diff").unlink()
exports["partial"] = export_run(ExportRuntime(d))

registry = {"version": 1, "projects": [{
    "project_id": "audit", "name": "Audit", "repository": str(base / "repo"),
    "workflows": [{"workflow_id": name, "runs_root": str(roots / name), "definition": {"name": "Feature implementation", "nodes": GRAPH_NODES}}
                  for name in sorted(exports)],
}]}
(base / "projects.json").write_text(json.dumps(registry, indent=2))
for name, value in exports.items():
    print(f"== {name}: version={value['version']} review={'null' if value['review'] is None else value['review']['transport'] + '/' + value['review']['verdict']} inputs={'null' if value['inputs'] is None else value['inputs']['mode']}")
print("registry", base / "projects.json")

def test_duplicate_run_is_not_relaunched(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
            (Path(root) / "project-workflows-001").mkdir()
            with patch("workflow.launch.subprocess.run") as command, contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
                with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
                    main(["project-workflows", "--live", "--run-root", root])
            command.assert_not_called()

    def test_run_id_cannot_escape_storage(self):
        for run_id in ("../other", "/tmp/other", "bad/id"):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                launch_commands(REPO, "project-workflows", run_id, Path("/tmp/workflow-launch-tests"))

    def test_export_is_stable_until_state_changes(self):

1	# PRD: Run inputs and finding-to-task links in the viewer (slice C)
2	
3	Status: Implemented 2026-09-21 on branch `ultra` directly in the checkout rather than as a feature run (see [HANDOFF_REVIEW_VISIBILITY.md](HANDOFF_REVIEW_VISIBILITY.md)); the `run-inputs` feature directory and launch choice exist for a later run. Umbrella: [PRD_REVIEW_VISIBILITY.md](PRD_REVIEW_VISIBILITY.md). Depends on slice B, because the finding-to-task link needs the findings panel.
4	
5	## 1. Goal
6	
7	Every run and every worker node shows its inputs: what the worker was asked to do, under what rules, and what it reported back. Each review finding links to the task text it relates to, so a reader can judge whether a finding is about something the worker was actually asked to do.
8	
9	Success: on a worker node, a reader sees the task, owned paths and checks beside the executed checks; on the review node, clicking a finding's requirement quote opens that worker's task scrolled to the quote.
10	
11	## 2. Confirmed decisions
12	
13	- Findings link to tasks through the `worker` and `requirement` fields the reviewer already fills in (slice A). A quote that is not found verbatim is shown without a link; the adapter never guesses a match.
14	- `workflow export <run>` (slice B) re-exports old runs, so project-workflows-001 gains an Assignment view after this merges.
15	
16	## 3. Pre-run work (ours, before `prepare`)
17	
18	| Where | Change |
19	| --- | --- |
20	| `contracts/projects` | new `runInputs` type: feature, base_commit, source_branch, mode, automatic settings, per-worker task, owned_paths, checks, launch receipt, completion, handoff. Version 1.2.0, additive |
21	| `contracts/projects/examples.ts`, `contract.test.ts` | fixtures including a run with `inputs: null` |
22	| `workflow/export_state.py` | `inputs` section in `run-state.json` from `plan.json`, `policy.json`, launch receipts, completion, handoff and stop files. Export version 1.2.0 |
23	| `workflow` tests | export and re-export tests extended for `inputs` |
24	
25	## 4. What is shown
26	
27	| Input | Producer file | Shown where |
28	| --- | --- | --- |
29	| Feature name, base commit, source branch, mode | `plan.json` | run header |
30	| Automatic settings: deadlines, permission mode, finish | `plan.automatic` | run header, automatic runs only |
31	| Task text per worker, rendered as Markdown | `plan.nodes.<worker>.task` | worker node "Task" panel; run "Assignment" tab |
32	| Owned paths and required checks | `policy.json` | worker node beside the task; check ids link to executed checks |
33	| Setup commands and attempt cap | `policy.json` | Assignment tab |
34	| Launch receipt: session UUID, requested and native start time, observed state | `<worker>.interactive.json` | worker node, replaces "No session recorded" |
35	| Completion signal: status, summary, open assumptions | `<worker>.completion.json` | worker node "Reported by the worker" |
36	| Handoff as accepted | `<worker>.handoff.json` | worker node, only when it differs from the completion signal |
37	| Stop confirmation time | `<worker>.stop.json` | worker node timeline |
38	
39	Rules: task text is the exact prompt the worker received, including the appended policy JSON; absolute paths pass through `redactPaths`; reads are bounded and oversized task text is truncated with a marker; inputs are pinned per run from the run's own files.
40	
41	## 5. Worker assignments
42	
43	Feature directory `features/run-inputs/`, same roles and ownership.
44	
45	| Worker | Owned paths | Deliverables | Checks |
46	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
47	| adapter | `server/`, `config/projects.example.json` | `.../runs/<run>/inputs` route from the export's `inputs` section; redaction and bounded reads; `inputs: null` for runs without the section; requirement-quote lookup exposed as a verbatim match flag per finding | `backend-unit`, `backend-regression`, `shared-contract`, `backend-build` |
48	| ui | `src/App.tsx`, `src/App.css`, `src/graph`, `src/projects`, `src/index.css`, `tests/project-workflows` | Assignment tab on the run; Task and Reported-by-worker panels on worker nodes; findings grouped by worker with requirement quotes that open the Task panel scrolled to the quote; mocks and seeds | `frontend-build`, `frontend-unit-regression`, `project-workflows-browser` |
49	
50	## 6. Acceptance scenarios
51	
52	| Scenario id | Asserts |
53	| --- | --- |
54	| run-assignment | the Assignment tab shows feature, branch, mode, deadlines, setup commands and both workers' tasks rendered as Markdown |
55	| worker-inputs | a worker node shows its task, owned paths, required checks linked to executed checks, launch receipt and completion signal |
56	| finding-to-task | a finding with a verbatim requirement quote links to the worker's Task panel and the quote is highlighted there; a finding whose quote is not found shows the quote without a link |
57	| inputs-legacy | a seeded run without the `inputs` section shows "inputs not recorded" and no error |
58	| paths-redacted | no absolute path from the seeded fixtures appears in the rendered inputs |
59	
60	## 7. Open questions
61	
62	- Task display: the exact prompt the model received (proposed) or the authored Markdown file. The exact prompt is honest but includes the policy JSON block and completion protocol.
63	- Measure the verbatim match rate of requirement quotes on this run before deciding whether fuzzy matching is worth building. Measured 2026-09-21 on the slice A live smoke test (a native reviewer over project-workflows-001's candidate): 8 of 8 quotes verbatim in the named worker's task, so verbatim matching stays.
64	
65	## 8. How to run
66	
67	```bash
68	.venv/bin/python -m workflow launch run-inputs --live --automatic --worker-timeout-seconds 7200
69	```
70	
71	Add `run-inputs` to the feature choices in `workflow/launch.py` first.

1	# Handoff: review visibility and run inputs (PRD_REVIEW_VISIBILITY, slices A, B, C)
2	
3	Implements `docs/PRD_REVIEW_VISIBILITY.md` and its three slice PRDs on branch `ultra` (worktree `~/dev/md-manager-ultra`), 2026-09-21. All three slices were implemented directly in this checkout rather than as feature runs; the feature directories `features/review-result/` and `features/run-inputs/` and the `launch` choices the PRDs ask for exist, so the runs can still be launched, but nothing in the tree depends on them. Commits are left to the user. Section 6 lists what was deliberately not done.
4	
5	## 1. What changed, by slice
6	
7	### Slice A: reviewer as an attachable native session (`workflow/`, `contracts/workflow/`)
8	
9	- `contracts/workflow/reviewCompletion.schema.json`: the reviewer's completion file (`version`, `run_id`, `node_id: "review"`, `launch_token`, `bundle_sha256`, `candidate_commit`, `verdict`, `findings[]` with `severity`, `message`, `disposition`, `worker` (`ui|adapter|both|none`) and `requirement` (verbatim quote or null)).
10	- `workflow/interactive.py`: `InteractiveSessions` knows the reviewer as node `review` (`launch_name` `workflow-<run>-reviewer`, `node_worktree` = `<run>/review-worktree`, `locate`/`settle` reused); `run_reviewer()` launches `claude --bg` with tools Read, Glob, Grep, Write, permission mode `dontAsk`, `--allowedTools Edit(//<run>/review.completion.json)`, `--add-dir <run>`, writes `review.interactive.json`, `review.prompt.txt`, `review.launch.log`; workers now also get `<worker>.prompt.txt`. `attach_panels` adds a third pane when the reviewer exists; `attach_reviewer_panel` adds it to an existing tab (split right of the adapter pane, label `Claude: reviewer`); `attach-one --node review`.
11	- `workflow/automatic.py`: `reviewer_transport` setting (`native` default, `print` fallback; plans pinned before the setting validate as native); `review_candidate` dispatches to `_review_native` (launch, `wait_review`, `read_review_completion` with schema validation and run/token/bundle/candidate binding, identity/independence/worktree/evidence re-checks, `review.json` for every verdict, identity-checked stop) or `_review_print` (the previous headless job, now also recording `worker`/`requirement`). Resume: a receipt at `running` re-enters `wait_review`; `KeyboardInterrupt` leaves the reviewer running. A native session in state `blocked` (needs a human in its pane) keeps the wait going until the deadline; no second reviewer is ever launched.
12	- `workflow/pipeline.py`: `launch_reviewer` (events with the reviewer UUID, best-effort pane), `stop_session`/`stop_reviewer` (generalised from `stop_workers`), `check_review`/`blocking_findings` (findings may carry `worker`/`requirement`; `require_approved=False` for export), `--reviewer-transport` at `prepare`, `ExportRuntime`/`export_run` and the `export` CLI action.
13	- `workflow/launch.py`: features `project-workflows`, `review-result`, `run-inputs`; `--reviewer-transport`; `--run-id` defaults to `<feature>-001`.
14	- Docs: `workflow/RUNBOOK.md` ("Automatic mode: the review step", resume path for the reviewer transcript, `workflow export`), `features/project-workflows/README.md` (new files, export 1.2.0 seam), `workflow/README.md`, `contracts/workflow/README.md`.
15	
16	### Slice B: review verdict and findings in the viewer (`contracts/projects/`, `workflow/export_state.py`, `server/`, `src/projects/`)
17	
18	- Contract 1.1.0/1.2.0: `reviewResult` (`.../runs/{run}/reviews/{attempt}`) in `contracts/projects/v1.ts` with `validateReviewResult`/`isBlockingFinding`, generated `reviewResult.schema.json`, fixtures and negative tests in `examples.ts`/`contract.test.ts`, README "Versions" section.
19	- Export 1.2.0 (`workflow/export_state.py`): `review` section from `review.json` plus the reviewer receipt (transport, session, `reviewed_at`, `review.diff` hash and size); `workflow export <run>` rebuilds `run-state.json` for old runs.
20	- Adapter (`server/projects.ts`, `server/projectRoutes.ts`): accepts export versions 1.0.0/1.1.0/1.2.0, projects the section (redaction, diff registered as artifact `patch-review-<sha12>` with hash and size checks), review node gets `session_id`/`result_uri`; 404 `REVIEW_NOT_FOUND` for runs without the section; strict section validation (`RUN_STORAGE_INVALID`, never a path).
21	- UI: review panel on the review node (verdict pill, reviewer session and transport, bundle hash linked to the candidate node, summary line, findings grouped by disposition, "Diff the reviewer saw"), "no review recorded" for legacy runs; mocks (worker phase) and seeds (candidate phase); scenarios `review-verdict`, `review-blocked`, `review-legacy`, `paths-redacted`.
22	
23	### Slice C: run inputs and finding-to-task links
24	
25	- Contract 1.2.0: `runInputs` (`.../runs/{run}/inputs`) and `requirement_found_in` on review findings (the lanes whose task text contains the quote verbatim; the adapter never guesses).
26	- Export: `inputs` section from `plan.json`, `policy.json`, launch receipts, completion signals, handoffs, stop files and the recorded prompts.
27	- Adapter: `.../inputs` route, redaction, 64 KiB truncation with a marker, timestamps normalised to `Z`, `INPUTS_NOT_FOUND` for runs without the section, verbatim quote lookup against the raw task text.
28	- UI: Assignment tab and run-header facts, worker node panels (Task with Rendered/Source toggle and highlight, Exact prompt, Launch receipt, Reported by the worker, Handoff as accepted, Stop confirmation), finding quotes linking to the worker's task scrolled to the highlighted quote; scenarios `run-assignment`, `worker-inputs`, `finding-to-task`, `inputs-legacy`, `inputs-paths-redacted`.
29	
30	## 2. Evidence
31	
32	(Filled in section 3 below as the gates ran; see the numbers there.)
33	
34	## 3. Gates run from the repository root
35	
36	| Gate | Result |
37	| --- | --- |
38	| `npm run test:contracts` | 13 passed (10 before; 3 new suites for review results and run inputs) |
39	| `npx --no-install tsx --test server/projects.test.ts` | 28 passed (22 before) |
40	| `npm run test:unit` | 130 passed |
41	| Python: `python -m unittest workflow.test_automatic workflow.test_interactive workflow.test_feature_launch workflow.test_sessions workflow.test_verification workflow.test_pipeline workflow.test_graph workflow.test_export` | 108 passed (59 before), re-run after the smoke-test fixes |
42	| `npm run build`, `npm run lint`, `git diff --check` | clean |
43	| Browser suite, worker phase: `npx --no-install playwright test --config=tests/project-workflows/playwright.config.ts` | 15 passed (6 before), 0 skipped, 47.9 s |
44	| Browser suite, candidate phase (`WORKFLOW_VERIFICATION_PHASE=candidate`, real adapter with seeded runs) | 15 passed, 0 skipped, 48.4 s |
45	
46	## 4. Red/green notes
47	
48	- Contract: the new schemas were written first with positive and negative fixtures; `npm run contracts:export` regenerated the JSON schemas; 13/13.
49	- Adapter: eight tests failed for the expected reasons against the old adapter (a 1.2.0 export was `RUN_STORAGE_INVALID`, the new routes were `NOT_FOUND`), then 28/28.
50	- Controller: the workstream reported behavioural reds per increment (fake reviewer through `FakeSessions`, four-process reviewer-interrupt recovery, every rejected completion file, print fallback), then 108/108.
51	- Live smoke test (slice A section 5), scratch run built from a copy of project-workflows-001's bundle, diff and packets with the review node driven on its own:
52	  - Attempt 1 failed in seven seconds and found a defect the offline tests could not: `--add-dir` is variadic, so the prompt that followed it was swallowed and the session started idle ("send a prompt to start"); the controller then saw the session's `blocked` state and stopped it. Fix: the prompt now follows `--permission-mode dontAsk` (single-valued) and a test pins that order; `wait_review` now treats `blocked` as "needs a human in the pane" and keeps waiting until the deadline instead of failing.
